rules.trigger_condition: Schedule performance index SPI drops below threshold 0.90 for two consecutive reporting periods
rules.recommended_action: Review critical path, initiate recovery planning and protect remaining float.

rules.trigger_condition: Cost performance index CPI drops below threshold 0.90 for two consecutive reporting periods
rules.recommended_action: Review cost commitments and change register; assess contingency drawdown.

rules.trigger_condition: No ground investigation report task explicitly named GI in WBS before detailed design
rules.recommended_action: Add and schedule an explicit ground investigation task before detailed design proceeds.

rules.trigger_condition: Public inquiry milestone slipped more than 30 days against baseline
rules.recommended_action: Escalate to sponsor, re-baseline downstream consents and construction, and assess float.

rules.trigger_condition: Ecology great crested newt mitigation season window closing with licence or works late
rules.recommended_action: Expedite the Natural England licence and re-sequence mitigation into the open season.

rules.trigger_condition: Critical path utility diversion slippage more than 14 days
rules.recommended_action: Joint review with undertakers; consider parallel works or temporary diversions.

rules.trigger_condition: Steel erection progress behind plan more than 10 percent
rules.recommended_action: Investigate site/supply causes and agree a recovery plan for structures.

rules.trigger_condition: Lane rental night closure budget consumed above 80 percent before completion
rules.recommended_action: Review closure productivity and overruns; re-sequence to reduce exposure.

rules.trigger_condition: Surfacing weather disruption days exceeding allowance or window closing
rules.recommended_action: Re-sequence final surfacing to the next window; protect contingency days.

rules.trigger_condition: VRS non-conformance raised in the quality register
rules.recommended_action: Quarantine affected system; verify certification before any opening.

rules.trigger_condition: Pavement compaction test failure rate above 5 percent for a lot
rules.recommended_action: Stop affected lot, investigate plant/method and rework as required.

rules.trigger_condition: Pavement design not aligned to standard CD 236 at the design gate
rules.recommended_action: Confirm compliance or raise a formal Departure from Standard.

rules.trigger_condition: Land acquisition CPO task not complete prior to phase 5 start
rules.recommended_action: Secure possession for affected plots or re-sequence construction around unavailable land.

rules.trigger_condition: BIM information model below required maturity level at a design gate
rules.recommended_action: Complete model updates to the required maturity before gate acceptance.

rules.trigger_condition: Health and safety near miss frequency rising over two periods
rules.recommended_action: Investigate trends (fatigue, TM, excavation) and reinforce controls.

rules.trigger_condition: Smart motorway MIDAS integration test failures recorded
rules.recommended_action: Triage defects, agree fixes and extend integration testing before go-live.

rules.trigger_condition: Lighting energisation incomplete against the commissioning programme
rules.recommended_action: Resolve cable/equipment completion and progress phased energisation.

rules.trigger_condition: Rework hours above 5 percent of construction hours
rules.recommended_action: Root-cause rework; review method statements and quality control.

rules.trigger_condition: Weather contingency days remaining below 20 percent of allowance
rules.recommended_action: Protect remaining days and re-sequence weather-sensitive works.

rules.trigger_condition: Embodied carbon tracked above the envelope per lane kilometre
rules.recommended_action: Review material options and design to bring carbon within budget.

rules.trigger_condition: Biodiversity net gain unit shortfall detected in the metric
rules.recommended_action: Secure additional compensation land or arrange statutory credits.

rules.trigger_condition: As-built survey data incomplete for completed structures
rules.recommended_action: Close the survey backlog for completed works before further progress.

rules.trigger_condition: Funding drawdown variance above 10 percent against profile
rules.recommended_action: Reconcile commitments and re-profile drawdown with the funder.

rules.trigger_condition: Procurement long lead items not on order before phase 5 start
rules.recommended_action: Place outstanding long-lead orders immediately; assess impact on critical path.

rules.trigger_condition: Traffic diverge merge layout safety audit comment raised
rules.recommended_action: Respond to RSA findings and amend TM tapers/layout before works proceed.

rules.trigger_condition: Milestone achievement rate below 75 percent over a rolling three-month period
rules.recommended_action: Review milestone slippage and agree recovery actions with the team.

rules.trigger_condition: Snagging closure rate below 60 percent approaching a stage 3 audit or handover
rules.recommended_action: Resource a snagging campaign and prioritise safety-critical items.

rules.trigger_condition: EIA chapter submission delayed against the consent programme
rules.recommended_action: Recover the submission timetable; protect the Draft Order Publication date.

rules.trigger_condition: Concrete strength cube test failure recorded on gantry foundations
rules.recommended_action: Investigate mix/curing; core or re-cast affected foundation before erection.

rules.trigger_condition: Community complaints per week above threshold 10
rules.recommended_action: Escalate community liaison and address the dominant complaint causes.
